name: Txt42
description: Integrates the Txt42 (ChatGPT) AI text-writing assistant into the CKEditor / N1ED editing toolbar.
project_description:
Txt42 plugin , built on cutting-edge GPT AI technology, assists you in generating high-quality content in real-time.

 Whether you require text for web pages, blogs, marketing materials, or other purposes, our plugin equips you with compelling statements, vivid descriptions, and precise wording.

 

 Select a portion of text or placing the cursor and clicking a toolbar button. The Txt 42 ChatGPT copywriting plugin suggests phrases, headlines, paragraphs, and even entire blocks of text tailored to your context and needs. You can also ask a question, and ChatGPT will respond to it. Just start typing in the text area.

 If you prefer working with the keyboard, the quick key combination Ctrl+Enter can replace the text generation button on the toolbar.
